subject: Telemetry add-ons — packaging, retention credits and counteroffer
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acme.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry add-ons — initial packaging and estimated credits

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call last week. Per our discussion, attached is a compact pricing layout for the observability add-ons you asked about — longer retention, distributed tracing, and our advanced dashboard pack. I pulled together two packaging options: a "Core" add-ons bundle (30-day retention + basic traces + standard dashboards) and an "Enterprise Telemetry" bundle (90-day retention + full tracing + advanced dashboards + SLA-backed ingestion limits).

High level:
- Core bundle: $6k/month (includes 2M trace events, 30-day retention)
- Enterprise Telemetry: $16k/month (includes 10M trace events, 90-day retention, advanced dashboard templates)
- One-time onboarding of $8k for dashboard templates and pipeline tuning

I've indicated suggested credits for multi-year commitments on page 2 of the attached PDF and a sample SOW for the onboarding work. If you want to explore a custom retention slice (45 or 60 days) we can sketch the unit economics and a credit schedule.

Next steps: if the Enterprise bundle looks like a fit I can loop in finance to propose a term discount and a sample contract redline. Otherwise tell me which components you want carved out (e.g., keep tracing but lower retention) and I will send an updated pricing grid.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_Addons_Pricing_v3.pdf (PDF, 48KB)], [Attachment: SOW_Acme_Observability.xlsx (XLSX, 22KB)]

Best,
Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform for production LLMs

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acme.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — initial packaging and estimated credits

Olga,

Thanks for the quick turn. The bundles make sense; appreciate the clarity. A few quick asks from procurement as we evaluate:

1) We are targeting a start date in Q3 and would need a 12-month commitment. Can you provide any flexibility on the onboarding fee?
2) We need a 25% list-price discount to get approvals (this is a stretch but it's the number my procurement team expects).
3) Is there a way to cap monthly overage fees for the first contract year?

If you can show a credit structure (or an alternate package) that closes the 25% gap we can move to contract review and circulate to legal.

Regards,
Elena Morris
Head of Observability | Acme Corporation
elena.morris@acme.com

Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — initial packaging and estimated credits

Elena —

Thanks for the signal. Quick answers:
- Onboarding: we can reduce the onboarding fee to $5k with a 12-month Enterprise Telemetry commitment (this covers dashboard template delivery and ingestion testing).
- Discount: 25% off list on the Enterprise bundle is outside typical up-front discounts for one-year terms, but we can propose a structured credit in lieu of list discount — for example, 12% up-front discount plus a $12k pre-purchased credit applied against overages and extended retention.
- Overage cap: we can add a soft cap for year one (notifications at 80%/100% and an overage rate no higher than 1.5x list rate; any sustained overages would trigger a review).

If those points are in the ballpark I'll loop in our finance lead to draft the term sheet and DocuSign-ready language.

Best,
Olga

> On Mon, Jun 22, 2026 at 11:05, Elena Morris <elena.morris@acme.com> wrote:
> > (procurement asks)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acme.com>, Acme IT Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Telemetry add-ons — pricing and procurement asks (need term approval)

Marissa / Ben —

Looping you in to negotiate the final commercial. Acme (Elena) is asking for a 25% discount and an overage cap; they are willing to commit 12 months and start in Q3. I have proposed an alternate structure: $5k onboarding, 12% up-front discount + $12k pre-purchased credit for overages/extended retention, and a 1.5x overage cap for year 1.

Attached are the pricing PDF and the SOW. Can finance confirm whether the $12k credit can be treated as a prepayment applied only to telemetry overages and retention extensions? Also need final approval to accept a 15% discount (Marissa, your threshold was 15% last quarter) or push back and hold out for a larger credit instead.

Thanks — please advise and I will take the response back to Elena.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_Addons_Pricing_v3.pdf], [Attachment: SOW_Acme_Observability.xlsx]

Olga

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Telemetry add-ons — pricing and procurement asks (need term approval)

Olga / Ben —

Thanks for the summary. Ben — please confirm finance treatment, but my recommendation: offer a 15% list discount on the Enterprise Telemetry bundle for a 12-month term with the $5k onboarding concession. In addition, accept a $10k pre-purchased credit (applied only to ingestion/retention overage and optional retention extension) rather than the $12k proposed. The cap on overage rate at 1.5x is acceptable for year one.

Rationale: 15% keeps our gross margin profile acceptable while the $10k credit gets procurement close to their ask without setting a precedent. If Acme insists on 25% list discount we should escalate to Sales Ops / Revenue Leadership.

Marissa
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — packaging, retention credits and counteroffer

Olga / Marissa,

Appreciate the fast turnaround. The 15% discount + $10k credit / $5k onboarding reduction is close. Two follow-ups before I take this to legal:

1) Can you confirm the $10k credit expires at the end of the 12-month term if unused? We need clarity on credit expiry.
2) We would like the overage notifications to include a weekly usage dashboard export for our SREs so they can proactively manage ingestion.

If you confirm the credit expiry and add the report export (we can accept a weekly CSV), I will ask legal to prep a redline and we can move to DocuSign.

Thanks,
Elena

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the clarity. Finance has approved the commercial terms as summarized below:

- Term: 12 months, Enterprise Telemetry bundle
- Monthly list: $16k/month (Enterprise bundle)
- Discount: 15% off list for the 12-month term
- Onboarding fee: reduced to $5k
- Pre-purchased credit: $10k (applies only to overage charges and retention extension fees). Credit expires at contract end (12 months).
- Overage policy: notifications at 80% and 100% thresholds; overage rate capped at 1.5x list for year one.
- Weekly usage export: Redwood will provide a weekly CSV usage report to the SRE email distribution specified in contract.

I have provisioned the DocuSign packet here: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcd-1234 — it contains the pricing exhibit and SOW with the agreed clauses. Once signed, billing will apply the credit schedule and onboarding invoice.

If that matches your expectations please sign and I will route countersigned copies.
